verdict.rationale: Pulley is a SaaS equity-management product, and whether its source is available under an open license is a fair question for software of this kind, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a source repository, an open-source license, or public code. The docs and probes cover only proprietary cap table, fundraising, compliance and help-center features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
